automationNotes: Doc: Enable Event Tracking — project → Environments → row ⋮ → Settings → Event Tracking tab → Enable Real-Time User Event Tracking toggle → consent checkbox → Yes, Enable Event Tracking. Then disable per doc (toggle again → Yes, Disable Event Tracking). Prerequisites (DAL/Lytics org setup) must be satisfied or toggles may be unavailable. DOM: data/dom/Launch/env-event-tracking.html. Lives under Data-and-Insights/set-up-data-insights for module grouping next to other Lytics/DAL flows. Redeploy, site consent modal, jstag.optIn/optOut, and caching notes are out of Launch UI scope.
